subject: prd/pipeline-measurement
statement: For every phase, the system shall compute the efficiency signals — questions, fog, rework, defects, latency — from the frozen artifacts and git history, with no runtime instrumentation.
rationale: the universal floor that interprets cost (J2)
fit_criterion: for a reference run on each supported harness, every phase carries efficiency signals derived solely from artifacts+git, identical across harnesses for the same run
